question: Should experimental Claw lifecycle diagnostics be accepted as a core Doctor contribution now, before the broader stacked Claw ownership workflow and RFC direction are settled?
rationale: The patch is intentionally gated and advisory, but it establishes a new core diagnostic owner over lifecycle state shared with several open stacked PRs; that product boundary cannot be determined from implementation quality alone.

options.title: Pause for stack direction
options.body: Keep this slice open until maintainers decide the Claw core boundary and the prerequisite ownership contract is ready to land.

options.title: Sponsor the core diagnostic slice
options.body: Approve the experimental core Doctor surface, then require current-head runtime proof and merge it in dependency order.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Move the diagnostics behind a later owner-specific or plugin-facing seam if maintainers do not want lifecycle diagnostics in core Doctor.

recommendation.title: Pause for stack direction
recommendation.body: Keep this slice open until maintainers decide the Claw core boundary and the prerequisite ownership contract is ready to land.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review identifies the most consequential runtime-health invariant for this diagnostic surface.
